propositions: Author a standing eval spec for the concurrency overlay mirroring code-review-tests.eval.yaml shape with 3 epochs, deterministic scorers, and all-or-nothing gating logic to prevent silent prompt regression against traced production race defects.

The gating dataset must include at least 2 scored recall cases (unlocked twin, check-then-act TOCTOU) and at least 3 scored no-fire cases, each with provenance comments naming source commits from the traced corpus.
R3 (fail-open guard) must be included as a non-scoring documented stretch case (commented hunk block with provenance and rationale) so it is tracked but cannot fail the gate by construction.

The spec header must document that coverage_threshold is a run-success floor only, and the only per-run tolerance is gate: at_least(2) over 3 epochs; a persistently-failing gating case fails the gate regardless of coverage_threshold.

Validation gate requires: spec well-formedness, unique case ids, expect values in known vocabulary, balanced fire/pass dataset, non-empty gold_set, and rebar prompt eval code-review-concurrency exit code 0.
